# wayfinder_workloadidentity (Resource)

WorkloadIdentity represents an identity for a kubernetes workload in a specific cloud provider / cloud account



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `metadata` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) Metadata associated to the resource (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--metadata))

<a id="nestedblock--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Required:

- `cloud` (String) Cloud defines which cloud provider this workload identity is for
- `cluster` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) Cluster is a reference to the cluster which this workload identity will be used in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--cluster))
- `role` (String) Role must be the name of a valid workload identity role known to Wayfinder Can optionally be None to indicate that no specific permissions are defined with the identity

Optional:

- `cloud_access_config_ref` (Block List, Max: 1) CloudAccessConfigRef defines which cloud access configuration to use to build this workload identity in (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--cloud_access_config_ref))
- `cloud_resource_name` (String) CloudResourceName specifies the name of the workload identity in the cloudaccount Can be left blank so that the name is derived from the cluster name + resource name
- `cluster_service_account` (Block List, Max: 1) ClusterServiceAccount is the name and namespace of the service account which will use this identity in the target cluster. Required on AWS and GCP, optional (and unused) on Azure at this time. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--cluster_service_account))
- `identity_only` (Boolean) IdentityOnly will create an identity associated with a cluster with no specific permissions Must specify Role=None if this is true. In AWS:
  - An IAM role is created and associated with a specific Kubernetes service account
  - no inline or attached policies are managed (post creation of the IAM role)
  - It is a "user" responsibility to attach policies to the IAM role
In Azure:
  - The user defined managed identity is created
  - No role definitions or role assignments are created
  - It is a "user" responsibility to create relevant role assignments
- `provider_details` (Block List, Max: 1) ProviderDetails provides additional fields which can be used for cloud-provider specific data needed to provision a workload identity (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--provider_details))
- `role_parameters` (Map of String) RoleParameters are any parameters required for the specified role
